name: coupon
rule: A coupon valid today takes 10 EUR off the goods

name: member
rule: A loyalty member gets 10% off, applied after the coupon

name: free_shipping
rule: Shipping is free when the discounted goods come to 50 EUR or more

name: zone
rule: Domestic shipping costs 5 EUR, international 20 EUR

name: gift_wrap
rule: Gift wrap adds 3 EUR to the parcel

name: vat
rule: Orders with a VAT ID are exempt, all others pay 20% VAT on goods and shipping

name: charge
rule: The payment provider answers Charged or Declined

name: reserve
rule: The warehouse answers Reserved or OutOfStock

name: confirm
rule: The mailer answers Sent or Bounced
